newsitem.title: UK: S&P ups Christiania Bank s-term rating.
newsitem.headline: S&P ups Christiania Bank s-term rating.

text.p: Standard and Poor's said on Monday it had raised its short-term counterparty and commercial paper rating of Christiania Bank og Kreditkasse to A1 from A2.
It said it had also raised its short-term commercial paper rating of Christiania Capital Corporation, guaranteed by Christiania Bank, to A1 from A2.
"Christiania Bank og Kerditkasse's ratings reflect the bank's significant role in the Norwegian banking sector and sound domestic franchise," S&P said in a statement.

"The bank has improved its asset quality and achieved good profitability and satisfactory capitalisation. With the bank's market becoming increasingly competitive and constraining income growth, the control of costs remains an important objective for the bank."
S&P said future profitability was largely dependent on the bank's strategy to diversify income streams through the cross-selling of products and services.
"S&P considers Christiania Bank og Kreditkasse is well placed to succeed in meeting its performance objectives, providing that costs can be constrained," S&P said.
